_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THPS3 level ports (tools/thps3_levels), approved by the user 2026-10-20. Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-10 .. TP-19). Capture the flag is decided on the server against its own flags; each side draws them from its own node array: these put our flags where THUGPRO's are, and our spawn points as THUGPRO's. TP-13 .. TP-19 (the user's decision 2026-10-20: everything THUGPRO changed, as data under the flag): its other hand edits of THPS3's nodes and collision - moved, flags, terrain, removed, renamed, rails, collision. Level keys are our (= THUGPRO's = THPS3's) level names. Read by tools/compat/compat.ts; `thps3_levels.ts convert --compat none` leaves all of it out (THPS3's own two bases). Regenerate: node tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro tools/compat/thugpro/thps3_levels.json

ctf_flags._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx, levels\<level>\<level>.qb: TRG_CTF_Red / _Blue (+ _Base) - pos in THUG2's world (Pos; Position with z negated), angles as they are. Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro.

team_nodes._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx, levels\<level>\<level>.qb: TRG_CTF_Green / _Yellow (+ _Base), TRG_Flag_<colour> (+ _Base), TRG_Team_Restart. Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro.

spawns._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx, levels\<level>\<level>.qb against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: every restart with a network type (MultiPlayer, Horse, Team, CTF*) THUGPRO moved, retyped, renamed or added (changed: pos in THUG2's world, angles, type, restart_types, restart_name, created), and THPS3's network restarts THUGPRO hasn't (removed). Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro.

moved._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (levels\<level>\<level>.qb) against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: the nodes THUGPRO moved or turned (not the network spawns - TP-12 - or the CTF / team nodes - TP-10 / TP-11): {name: pos in THUG2's world, angles}. Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (nodeEdits).

flags._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (levels\<level>\<level>.qb) against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: CreatedAtStart / AbsentInNetGames / NetEnabled / TrickObject THUGPRO added or removed on the nodes it kept of the same kind (one it made another class is its toolchain's form: not here). Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (nodeEdits).

terrain._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (levels\<level>\<level>.qb) against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: every TerrainType THUGPRO changed: {name: THUGPRO's terrain}. Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (nodeEdits).

removed._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (levels\<level>\<level>.qb) against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: THPS3's nodes THUGPRO hasn't (not renamed) that no script or other node of THPS3's names (the level's .qb, Data\Scripts). Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (nodeEdits).
shp: Box07
Box08

renamed._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (levels\<level>\<level>.qb) against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: {THPS3's name: THUGPRO's}: a THUGPRO-only node at the place of a THPS3-only node of the same class whose name no script uses. Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (nodeEdits).

rails._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (levels\<level>\<level>.qb) against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.qb: the RailNodes THUGPRO added, as node data: pos in THUG2's world, angles, TerrainType, flags, Cluster, Links by name. Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (nodeEdits).

collision._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>col.prx / <level>scn.prx against THPS3's Data\Levels\<Lvl>\<lvl>.bsp: an object THUGPRO draws without collision (drop), the faces THUGPRO's object lacks (remove: THPS3's own corners, in THPS3's order). Extracted by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro (collisionEdits).

thugpro_new._register: TPN-THPS3-1 ... TPN-THPS3-6 (README.md here: "New in THUGPRO (not in any source game)")
thugpro_new._source: References only (the user's decision 2026-10-20, with Morten1337's permission): what is new in THUGPRO's THPS3 ports, in no source game - archive and file in THUGPRO's data\pre, the item's name and a CRC-32 of it. tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_new.ts reads the bytes from the user's THUGPRO install (--thugpro) at convert time; a missing or different item is warned about and skipped. Each entry (compat.ts Entry): id, op (add / set / remove), kind (sector, collision, node, script, model), target {level, name}, why. Found by tools/thps3_levels/thugpro_new_extract.ts (--extract-thugpro); never typed in. _left_out: what was found and not taken, with the reason.

free_skate._source: THUGPRO's Foundry scripts (data\pre\FOUN_scripts.prx: foun_scripts.qb CJR_Foun_LoadingScript / CJR_Foun_Valve_Check / CJR_Foun_Secret_Gen_Doors) read against THPS3's cjr_scripts.qb. THUGPRO runs every game, free skate too, as a network game: THPS3's `InMultiPlayerGame` is `InNetGame` there, so the level always takes THPS3's multiplayer branch - the generator's doors open, GenDoor01/02/03_Open made, the closed doors killed, the secret generator room (TRG_Ledge_SecretGen*, Secret_Gen*, Collision_Secret_Gen*, Air_Polys_Secret_Gen*) made. THPS3's own free skate (not career, no network) leaves them closed until the career's valve goal sets CJR_FLAG_GEN_OPEN. Our ports have no career: in a network game ours already takes the multiplayer branch (THUG2's InMultiplayerGame is true there too), so online both sides agree; offline free skate: the flag set from <level>_setup.

si.what: Skater Island's outer door (SI_OuterDoor, with the banner SI_Sponsors06 and light si_lighting02 THPS3 takes down with it) is gone in free skate: THPS3 blows it with the cannon goal (ALF_SI_BlowDoor, ALF_SI_CheckFlags: SI_FLAG_OUTSIDE_OPEN) or, in a multiplayer game, kills it from ALF_SI_Unhide_Inside (`if InMultiPlayerGame`); THUGPRO's SI_OuterDoor is CreatedAtStart + AbsentInNetGames (TP-14) and its free skate is a network game. Killed a second after ALF_SI_Init made it (no shatter, no sound); the outside is reachable

foun.what: Foundry's GENERATOR 1 CORE doors (GenDoor01 / 02, the big double door, and GenDoor03) open in free skate and the generator room behind is reachable, as in THUGPRO and THPS3's multiplayer: CJR_Foun_Valve_Check's GetFlag branch (kills the GenDoor_Closed* sectors, makes GenDoor01-03_Open) - the same script THPS3's career runs once the five valves are un-jammed

port_changes._comment: Our own changes to THPS3's level data (tools/thps3_levels): neither THPS3's nor THUGPRO's. Read by tools/compat/compat.ts portChanges whatever the profile (--compat none keeps them); --no-port-changes leaves out every entry but the required ones (the game needs those to load or run the level). Each entry (compat.ts Entry): id (PC-THPS3-n), op (add / set / remove), target {what, levels: the THPS3 folders it applies to or "*"}, why, required (true: a level needs it to load or run - kept with --no-port-changes), and the data the converter takes from it. Registered in tools/compat/thugpro/README.md, "Our own changes (port_changes)". Not extracted: --extract-thugpro keeps this section as it is.

target.what: Warehouse's dark set: the sectors and nodes named SkWare_Dark* (prefixes)

entries.why: THPS3's scripts switch between the lit and the dark copies of the same surfaces; drawn both, they fight over them (flicker). The lit copy stays shown: the scripts' Invisible / Kill prefix= of it are left out too (JKU_Ware_RoomFlicker hid it for 10-120 frames at a time with nothing under it - half the level black)

target.what: the level's start scripts (Load_<level>'s calls, the Player1 restart's and the ProximNodes' trigger scripts) run once from <level>_setup, the level structure's setup_script

entries.why: THUG2 has no hook for THPS3's load scripts or a restart's trigger script; its load_level calls the setup script

target.what: kill zones: THPS3's kill scripts as THUG2's SK3_KillSkater with a restart to go to (nodes.killCommands / addKillRestarts)

entries.why: THPS3's own kill is engine code THUG2 hasn't

target.what: Multiplayer / Horse restart types on the Player1 restarts of a level without network restarts (nodes.netRestarts: the tutorials, the skate shop)

entries.why: a network game needs somewhere to put the players, as THUG2's own skate shop has

target.what: AbsentInNetGames on path followers, peds and cars there at the start (nodes.absentInNetGames)

entries.why: a network game has no path manager and loads no ped animations: a ped's first animation reads through the missing one (0x00482BA0)

target.what: TrickObject / Cluster taken off geometry nodes without a scene sector (nodes.stripMissingTrickObjects)

entries.why: ParseNodeArray (0x00588630) reads through the missing sector: THPS3 Airport crashed loading

target.what: restarts over nothing or over a kill zone: no network spawn types, not a kill's target (nodes.groundRestartsAt)

entries.why: a player spawned there falls or dies at once

target.what: capture the flag: TRG_CTF_<colour> flags, their bases and team restarts made from THPS3's flag bases (gamemode.qb flag1_info / flag2_info) in THUG2's form

entries.why: THUG2's CTF looks its game objects up by THUG2's names; THPS3's bases are generic nodes it ignores. TP-10 .. TP-12 build on them: kept with --compat thugpro

target.what: the Player1 restart moved to the front of the node array, Links following (levels without TP-12's spawn order)

entries.why: the skater starts at the first player restart of the array

target.what: THPS3's traffic (trigger scripts calling Car_Generic01) as THUG2's cars: THUG2's car models on the same waypoints

entries.why: THUG2 can't drive THPS3's models as vehicles (no skeleton); THUG2's Car_Generic01 run by a LevelObject crashes

target.what: THPS3's peds as THUG2's ped AI and profiles (thps3_ped_walk / thps3_ped_stand), THPS3's birds and sharks as THUG2's animals

entries.why: THPS3's skinned peds, their animations and scripts can't run in THUG2

target.what: goal pickups (letters, stat points, tapes, deck icons), cars and birds not there at the start, objects whose model isn't converted, proximity nodes without a script

entries.why: no career goals in the ports; the rest needs THPS3 code or models THUG2 can't use

target.what: THPS3 script statements THUG2 can't run (LoadSound, AddMusicTrack, SetParticleSysVisibility...) and trigger scripts that aren't brought along

entries.why: THUG2 runs a TriggerScript without checking it exists; an unknown command would fail

target.what: the Links of nodes other than rails (sector nodes to restarts and each other)

entries.why: THUG2's node loader follows a non-rail node's links as a path

target.what: plain moving props THUGPRO made Vehicles (TPN-THPS3-3 `set`, left out for them): Foundry's molten-metal bucket and Tokyo's two bullet trains stay our LevelObjects (drawn with THPS3's own model, moved by THPS3's scripts with THPS3's timing) and get CollisionMode=Geometry - their collision the level's collision object of their name, in their own space: THUGPRO's when TPN-THPS3-1 adds one (the bucket's 134 faces), else made from the drawn geometry (the trains) - tools/level_port/movers.ts

entries.why: THUGPRO made this non-car a Vehicle to get path movement + collision; THUG2 builds solid moving props as LevelObjects with CollisionMode=Geometry (Boston's subway trains, New Orleans' blades), Vehicle only for movers carrying rails / trigger nodes in their model's node array (Barcelona's bridges, boat, tram); client-side only - moving level objects aren't sent over the network
entries.online: needs a hand check: THUGPRO's players have Vehicles (THUGPRO's models) there; the three are AbsentInNetGames, so neither side makes them in a network game

objects.name: Obj_Bucket
objects.what: the molten-metal bucket (THPS3's CJR_Foun_Bucket: Obj_MoveToNode out, tips with Obj_RotX); THPS3's bucket kills no one (TRGP_Kill_Bucket is a static gap trigger) - THUGPRO's kill inside it (its model's TRGP_KillSkaterBucket -> FOUN_BucketKillSkater01, THUGPRO's TP_DoFlash) isn't brought

entries.kept_vehicles: Vehicles kept as THUGPRO makes them: Tokyo's three jets TRG_Plane_* (plane_jet: its node array's trigger node Box02) and Subway's plane TRG_Plane (light_airplane01: trigger nodes TRGP_CarPlant01 / TRGP_Killskater01) - movers carrying trigger nodes, THUG2's Vehicle form; Rio's 8 and Subway's 1 invisible carplant_collision Vehicles (Obj_LockToObject on a car) - left for a separate decision; road traffic (Tokyo's 18 cars, Subway's ice-cream truck) and every car our converters make

target.what: CreatedAtStart for pieces only a career, goal, multiplayer, network or split-screen branch of a start script makes (createdAtStart follows an `if IsCareerMode` / GetGoal / InMultiPlayerGame / InNetGame / InSplitScreenGame branch only where it is false: offline free skate): Tokyo's career-opened secret buildings (Tok_Secret_Building00_*) and the destroyed sign (Tok_Mid_Sign_Destroyed*) are no longer there - drawn and collided with next to the buildings and sign they replace - at the start of free skate; they stay in the node array for the scripts that make them

entries.why: THPS3's start scripts make them only in the career (JS_Mid_Smasher_CareerRestart: IsCareerMode and the TOK_SECRET_AREA_OPEN flag) or by a goal script; the static follow took both branches of every `if`, so free skate had both the building and its replacement

target.what: every node kind's common fields (all but Pos / Position / Angles / Name / Links / TriggerScript) as global structures the nodes name, <level>_inc_<n> - the converter's last step on the level's .qb (nodes.shareNodeFields), after every pass that reads nodes' own fields

entries.why: node fields shared the way THUG2's own levels do (ncomp_*), so big levels fit the script component pool
